name: 01-cover-drive.jpg
caption: Golden hour on Ocean Boulevard: chase-cam behind the clearcoat Solaris GT with its Bay Cyan neon underglow under a layered tropical sunset, a two-star SBPD cruiser closing on its rear quarter in cyan-and-gold unit livery. Traffic runs both ways and strollers fill both pavements under the Art Deco neon. Mission 02 is on the objective card, Elena is on comms in the crew strip over the minimap, and the minimap tints the Palm Strip by district standing.

name: 02-police-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star sunset pursuit on Ocean Boulevard: an SBPD roadblock ahead, two cruisers nose-in in a diagonal V with striped sawhorse barriers and a fan of burning red road flares, while Air One hovers overhead with its searchlight pinning the drifting supercar and two interceptors ride its bumpers. The SBPD DISPATCH · AIR ONE radio card is top-left and the crew strip shows Elena on the SBPD band and Mateo riding shotgun.

name: 03-on-foot-heist.jpg
caption: Mission 03 cover shootout at the Solaris Vault Bank Plaza: the player kneels in low cover at the tail of the teal Coastal Muscle and fires over the boot, while crewmate Mateo kneels off the nose in a plate carrier and watch cap, laying cyan covering bursts on the armoured vault guards. Guard return fire streaks orange toward the car. The IN COVER chip, the crew strip (Mateo · COVERING FIRE) and Mateo's dialogue sit on the HUD.

name: 04-city-map.jpg
caption: The city menu (M) over the night skyline: the organic coastal map of Solaris Bay with district control tints and a District Standing panel (Palm Strip 72% RESPECTED to Starlight Key 6%, +$260/min, garage -5%). The sidebar lists all eight story jobs with their districts, the crew roster with Elena and Mateo deployed, activities with medals, personal bests and an x1.75 streak, and the garage upgrades. The header's save pill reads SLOT 1 · AUTO-SAVED 22:04 with 3 SAVE SLOTS · 2 USED, beside a SAVES tab that writes and loads the three slots.
